value.name: leans on warm wood post
value.description: Asha rests her weight briefly on the wooden post, noticing its warmth.
evidence: she let her own weight rest on it briefly. The wood was warm.

value.name: registers house silence
value.description: Asha takes in the quiet of the house, with only a radiator ticking in the kitchen.
evidence: The house was very quiet. Somewhere in the kitchen a radiator ticked.

value.name: observes mourners at dining table
value.description: Asha notices three people in the dining room sitting together in silence, each connected to the same woman in different ways.
evidence: Somewhere in the dining room behind her three people who had loved the same woman in three different and incompatible ways were sitting at a table together and not yet speaking

value.name: anticipates decisive conversation
value.description: Asha understands that what the three people say when they begin speaking will shape the fate of the house and everyone in it.
evidence: what they would say to each other when they did begin to speak would determine, more than any of the paperwork Asha was about to file, what happened to this house and to each of them.

value.name: realizes legal work is nearly complete
value.description: Asha recognizes that the legal task she was hired to do is almost finished.
evidence: She knew, standing there with her hand on the post, that the legal work was nearly done.

value.name: plans codicil filing
value.description: Asha confirms that the codicil exists and will be filed.
evidence: The codicil existed. The codicil would be filed.

value.name: expects will amendment by week’s end
value.description: Asha knows the 2020 will will be amended of record by the end of the week.
evidence: The 2020 will would be amended of record by the end of the week.
value.time_hint: by the end of the week

value.name: assesses job as successful
value.description: Asha judges that she has completed her assignment faster and with less fallout than expected.
evidence: By any professional measure she had done what she had been retained to do, in less time than she had feared, with less collateral damage than she had braced for.
